name: 0.1.0-beta.14
notes:
# Folian 0.1.0-beta.14

A clearer writing experience, stronger project ownership and deeper Story Bible development.

- New Light mode gives you a white writing canvas and neutral application chrome, alongside Paper and Dark.
- A simpler Home highlights your current writing, one next step and useful progress. Project creation keeps advanced setup optional.
- Cleaner manuscript navigation keeps chapters and scenes compact while retaining search, collapse and reordering.
- Your files and Help → Where is my manuscript? explain where your work is saved and provide a direct manuscript export path.
- Export full manuscripts, chapters, chapter ranges or scenes as DOCX or Markdown. Markdown preserves prose, headings, paragraphs and emphasis where representable.
- Expanded AI-assisted development for Characters, Locations, Relationships, Canon, Timeline and Planning. Suggestions remain reviewable: AI proposes, the writer decides.
- Chapter planning offers clearer briefs, missing-field proposals and inline decisions that save once to your chosen destination.
- Chapter AI uses more reliable source context and preserves paragraph and list boundaries.
- Editing follows the selected chapter or scene, with clearer source-aware History and safer proposal review.
- Accepted development proposals save their records and review History together, with recovery for retried requests.
- Desktop recovery backups use verified snapshots and include local files. Portable project archives remain separate from complete recovery backups.
